semantics.timing_evidence: Original specifies a multiplexer without clock or cycle behavior; output follows current inputs without added latency.
semantics.reset_initialization_evidence: Original interface has no reset or clock; no state or initialization requirement is specified.

numeric.operation: Bit-preserving selection, with no arithmetic or signed interpretation.

verification.oracle: Independent indexed input array derived from original sel=0 chooses a, sel=1 chooses b, etc.; sel >= 9 expects 65535.
cases: Zero, all-one, alternating, and per-bit walking patterns on every data input
Deterministic varied data with every selector
Selected input changes with selector held fixed
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then sample after 1 ns combinational settling; no clock/reset phases exist.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all cases succeed.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for selector containing X or Z is unspecified; verification constrains selector to binary values.
